Marcus / Camila —

I pulled the auth service traces and started a correlation of token failures across regions. Initial notes: a spike of 502/504 gateway timeouts from one downstream vendor between 08:50–09:05 PST; user impact concentrated in our west region (approx 14% of requests failing). Pasted relevant tail below.

--- begin snippet ---
2026-12-04T08:52:14Z auth-service ERROR downstream timeout vendor-x 504 request_id=...
2026-12-04T08:53:01Z auth-service WARN token-validate latency-ms=3200 user=...
--- end snippet ---

I’m on standby on the new bridge. If we confirm downstream vendor issues, mitigation options: 1) failover to cached auth token path, 2) temporarily relax token validation TTL for affected sessions. Both require engineering sign-off.

Evelyn
SRE, Redwood Inference
